requires: exact checkpoint metadata and discrete sample/noise/sigma trajectory
matching J controls/signature and frozen summaries

numerical_diagnostics.comparison_slack: one float64 ULP of each observed bound
numerical_diagnostics.relative_l2_definition: norm(left-right) / max(norm(left), norm(right)); zero if both are zero
numerical_diagnostics.interpretation: Descriptive envelope from two independent continuation repeats; not a confidence bound. Outside-envelope values require parent assessment before formal training, but do not fail the exact-restore hard gate. CUDA warn-only determinism remains partial (Flash/grid-sample/upsample/pooling reductions may vary).
